data.lore: A chimney of black glass with a rite burning at the top of it. The smoke has not changed colour in living memory.
data.name: The Cinderspire
data.tagline: Accuracy and crit rate — behind a shield that counts your blows.

data.lore: A strongroom the Sskarn did not build and cannot open, guarded by something that was left behind with instructions.
data.name: Frostgrave Vault
data.tagline: Guard, resistance, and a sentinel that answers every wound.

data.lore: A fighting pit older than the invasion, taken over and run exactly as it was. Drazhak keeps the rules; nobody has asked him to.
data.name: The Proving Grounds
data.tagline: Emblems, and a pitmaster whose patience runs out on a timer.

data.lore: The warren under the warren. Every passage is somebody’s nursery, and she knows when one of them goes quiet.
data.name: Silkmire Depths
data.tagline: Lifesteal and regeneration — and rings, amulets and banners below the tenth.

data.lore: Not water so much as heat that has agreed to hold a shape. It will not hold it every day.
data.name: The Ember Spring
data.tagline: Ember essence, on its own days.

data.lore: Open one day in seven. Wardens who have tried to find it on a Monday report finding nothing at all.
data.name: The Mist Spring
data.tagline: Mist essence, on its own days.

data.lore: Colourless, tasteless, and useful to absolutely everyone — which is why it is the only one never barred.
data.name: The Pure Spring
data.tagline: Pure Essence, every day of the week.

data.lore: Salt, this far inland, and it rises and falls to something that is certainly not the moon.
data.name: The Tide Spring
data.tagline: Tide essence, on its own days.

data.lore: It runs green and slow through a root-cellar of a cave, and only on the days the roots allow.
data.name: The Verdant Spring
data.tagline: Verdant essence, on its own days.

data.lore: A wind-cut throat in the rock that goes down further than anyone has mapped. Something at the bottom of it has been breathing the same air for six hundred years.
data.name: Wyrm's Hollow
data.tagline: Speed and crit damage — and the thing that has always lived here.
